novelty_flags.one_line: The related-work scan omits the close graphical sequential-proxy comparator ShpitserWoodDoughtyTchetgen2023, whose sequential bridge results explicitly retain completeness; its non-subsumption must be established before claiming a below-completeness causal advance.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 (wbc-target-span-identification)
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The causal conclusion is conditional on every compatible SCM admitting at least one bridge simultaneously valid for the latent sequential equations and the observed system, and on the two target-relevant latent transport-overlap restrictions.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Point identification is claimed only over the stated conditional WBC SCM class; it is not an observable-law characterization of when latent bridge validity holds.
